headline: NBA: Giannis posts 27-point triple-double to beat former team Bucks 137-130 in Miami reunion
teaser: Giannis Antetokounmpo delivers 27 points, 14 rebounds, and 9 assists against Milwaukee, while Bam Adebayo pours in 26 points to power the Heat to their sixth straight victory.
story:
In an emotionally charged reunion at Kaseya Center on Wednesday night, 18 November, Giannis Antetokounmpo faced his former franchise for the first time since joining Miami, leading the Heat to an exhilarating 137-130 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.

The two-time MVP dominated the interior, racking up 27 points, 14 rebounds, and nine assists while orchestrating Miami's high-octane offense. Bam Adebayo complemented Giannis with 26 points and 10 rebounds, while Tyler Herro buried five three-pointers to finish with 23 points as the Heat (9-3) extended their winning streak to six games.

Milwaukee fought tenaciously behind Kyle Kuzma, who poured in 26 points, and Damian Lillard, who added 24 points and eight assists. But a decisive 14-4 Heat surge early in the fourth quarter provided enough cushion for Miami to hold off the Bucks' frantic late three-point shooting barrage.
whyCareReason: Giannis Antetokounmpo delivers a masterpiece against his former franchise to extend Miami's winning streak to six games.
stakes: Miami (9-3) solidifies second place in the Eastern Conference standings, while Milwaukee (6-7) drops below .500.
rivalryAngle: High-profile emotional showdown as Giannis faced the team he led to the 2021 NBA championship for the very first time in Heat colors.
funFacts: Giannis Antetokounmpo fell just one assist shy of a 27-point triple-double against his former team.
The Heat scored a season-high 137 points on 54.3 percent shooting from the field.
Miami has now won six consecutive regular-season games, the longest active streak in the East.
